name: Professor Horace Slughorn

identity.role: Hogwarts Potions master and former Slytherin Head of House, returns after retirement
identity.canon_role: Founding host of the Slug Club; cultivates talented and well-connected students; connected with memories about young Tom Riddle

personality.core_traits_and_context: Sociable, jovial, vain about connections, ambitious and self-protective; capable of genuine courage and care, not merely a villain or blustering clown.
personality.voice_register: Effusive, flattering and anecdotal when networking; becomes wary or evasive around shame and complicated history.

relationships.Snape: Potions colleague and former teacher; specific red-ink corrections to teenage Snape's school essay are fiction-specific.
relationships.Lily: Former gifted pupil; canonical memory of her talent is relevant but do not turn her life into a collectible.

source_evidence.detail: His morally mixed character and heroism
His corrections on Severus's old essays are story continuity

known_unknowns: exact wording of feedback to school-age Snape
writer_constraints: Do not treat the fic's red-ink corrections as a canonical historical artifact. Dialogue must keep Slughorn's specific social charm and blind spots distinct from Iroh, Greg, and Severus.

scene_use.continuity: Preserve observed choices, debts, work, risks, and consequences between chapters.
scene_use.pov: Jasper narrates only what can be observed, read or plausibly inferred.
scene_use.romance: These are supporting characters; no new romance arc is implied.
